customer_question: Now that our compliance folder has been delivered, how long do we need to keep it, and what is it actually for?
question_variants: Is there a retention period for the compliance folder after registration?
What happens if Bluetooth SIG asks to see our compliance folder?
Has any of your other clients actually been audited by Bluetooth SIG?
actual_issue: After the compliance folder was delivered and registration completed, the customer needed to understand how long the folder needed to be retained and under what circumstances it would actually be needed.
plain_english_explanation: The compliance folder isn't just a one-time deliverable to file away -- it has to be kept on hand for a defined period after the product stops being sold, in case Bluetooth SIG ever decides to audit the registration. It's compared to keeping a vehicle's inspection certificate: you need it on hand to prove compliance if asked, even though most people never actually get asked. As reassurance, none of this consultant's other registration-support clients have ever actually faced an audit.
consultant_answer: The compliance folder should be retained for one year after the end of sales of the product(s) listed in the registration's Product List, to be presented if and when Bluetooth SIG conducts an audit -- comparable to a vehicle's roadworthiness inspection certificate, which exists to be shown if requested rather than used day to day. None of the consultant's prior registration-support clients have actually experienced an SIG audit, offered as reassurance.
decision_logic: A completed compliance folder is not merely a delivery artifact; it carries an ongoing retention obligation -- one year past the registered product's end of sales -- specifically tied to the possibility of a Bluetooth SIG audit, even though such audits have not been observed in this consultant's client history.
final_recommendation: Advise customers to retain their compliance folder for at least one year after the registered product's end of sales, explaining that its purpose is to be available in case of a Bluetooth SIG audit, while noting that such audits have not occurred among this consultant's registration-support clients to date.
risk_if_done_wrong: Discarding the compliance folder before the one-year post-end-of-sales retention period elapses would leave the customer unable to respond if Bluetooth SIG were to request it during an audit.
